opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research grants up to £20,000; Research and Travel grants up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating in a non-profit capacity for at least 12 months) for New Projects & Commissions, Acquisitions & Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications and Long-Term Research. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators can apply under the Research and Travel category. Applications from individuals wishing to develop their own artistic practice are not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research expanding appreciation of sculpture. Covers exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, and collections development (acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing, display). Applications are considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open for projects starting no sooner than 1 January 2027.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships (Henry Moore Institute)

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600; Europe up to £700; Rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire for the duration of the fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Visiting Research Fellowships for academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture; Artist Research Fellowships for artists to develop their practice through research (research only, no studio facilities); Senior Fellowships (six weeks) for established scholars.
opportunities.summary: Fellowship programme enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's research facilities in Leeds or Hertfordshire (Studios & Gardens for Henry Moore-specific research). Includes accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize for BA dissertation and £250 cash prize for MA dissertation, plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50, copies of dissertations added to the Research Library, and publication of dissertation abstracts on the website

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to BA and MA students of all disciplines at UK universities, for a dissertation submitted within the past academic year at a UK university and relating directly to sculpture. Dissertations must not have been previously published.
opportunities.summary: Annual prize awarding two prizes (one BA, one MA) for outstanding extended writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture, with a strong focus on secondary and primary sources and original research. Submissions for the next prize open in autumn.
